changes.title: Hidden trees
items: The treehouse draws faster: trees hidden behind the Ent are no longer drawn

changes.title: Telescope sharper
items: The telescope's view is as sharp as the game's own on laptops with built-in graphics (it was drawn at half resolution there)

changes.title: Finds flask
items: Tonight's find is one small object (a folded bundle of clothes, a bag or the broom part itself) tied with a pale ribbon, on a patch of clear ground in its own pale gold-white light: look for the glow under the trees
No more trunks and crashed brooms: once you've taken the find, its light goes out
